ترافعت (form VI)
# تَرَافَعْتُ (tarāfaʕtu) /ta.raː.faʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَرَافَعَ (tarāfaʕa)
# تَرَافَعْتَ (tarāfaʕta) /ta.raː.faʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَرَافَعَ (tarāfaʕa)
# تَرَافَعْتِ (tarāfaʕti) /ta.raː.faʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَرَافَعَ (tarāfaʕa)
# تَرَافَعَتْ (tarāfaʕat) /ta.raː.fa.ʕat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
